# Plaincast — what the forecast actually says

> The National Weather Service's Area Forecast Discussion — the real forecast, written 3 to 4 times a day by the meteorologist on shift — translated into plain English.

An Area Forecast Discussion is where a forecaster explains their reasoning: which models disagree, what they are watching, how confident they are, and what would have to change for the forecast to bust. It is the most informative weather product the government publishes and the least readable, because it is written in dense shorthand for other meteorologists. Plaincast decodes it, and shows the plain-English summary beside the annotated original so the forecaster's own words are always one glance away.

## How to use it

- Any of 123 forecast offices: `https://plaincast.live/o/<CODE>/` — a three-letter NWS office code, e.g. [/o/OKX/](https://plaincast.live/o/OKX/) for New York. Every code is listed in [/llms.txt](https://plaincast.live/llms.txt).
- What changed since the previous discussion: `https://plaincast.live/o/<CODE>/?view=changelog`
- Where the weather is today, nationally: [The National Desk](https://plaincast.live/national/)
- RSS per office: `https://plaincast.live/api/feed?office=<CODE>`
- Every page on this site serves this Markdown representation to `Accept: text/markdown`.

For a life-safety decision, read the original at [weather.gov](https://www.weather.gov). Plaincast summarizes a discussion product that can be several hours old.

---

## Today's edition — Los Angeles (LOX)

> Issued Friday, July 3 at 4:40 AM PDT. This is the edition the site opens to by default; it is not a national summary. Read another office at `https://plaincast.live/o/<CODE>/`.

### Synopsis

Low clouds and fog will continue each night and morning with a chance of drizzle near the coasts through the weekend across the region.

### Short Term

Marine layer around 1500 feet deep this morning. A wknd warming trend is expected as high pressure builds over the region with temperatures above normal in the valleys by Saturday afternoon and evening.

Full Los Angeles edition: [https://plaincast.live/o/LOX/](https://plaincast.live/o/LOX/)
